name: growth-share
description: A brand-neutral React, Vite, and WebGL event-wall template with synthetic profiles and a repository-level Codex Skill.

scripts.generate:avatars: uv run --with-requirements scripts/requirements-avatar.txt python scripts/generate-stylized-avatars.py && npm run update:avatar-manifest
scripts.generate:synthetic: npm run generate:profiles && npm run generate:avatars
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:sites
scripts.test:sites: npm run build && npm run test:sites:built
scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:sites
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:generated && npm run test:config && npm run test:portability
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:assets && npm run build:sites && npm run test:sites:built && npm run audit
